description: Plan v7 section 8.3 runtime-limits clause: maximumInterpolatedOutputCharacters pinned exactly at 8, with bidiIsolation left at the library default so per-call overrides can be measured against it. StringInterpolator.appendChecked bounds the OUTPUT builder, not the template, so 'Hi {{name}}' separates value length from template length. When isolation is in force the interpolator hands BidiUtils.BoundedIsolatedValue the REMAINING budget for rendering while DefaultStrings.java:1367 passes it the FULL maximum for error reporting, so the FSI and PDI markers are charged against the same 8 characters but the message still names 8. The Fragment keys put an 8- and a 9-character generated fragment at depth 1, where the same cap applies per expansion and the failure is contextualized by placeholder.
